title: C05 锁区续接与回望
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is C05 semantic world-extension planning. Starting from this top-down level planning map, extend the canvas to the NORTH (upward) by about half the existing height. Preserve the entire existing lower map: its river shape, existing purple high terrace, orange crossing and climbing route, mountain silhouettes and starting dot. In the NEW upper area add an irregular connected valley, a winding river outlet joining the previously existing upper-left lake, a rock ridge continuing a mountain boundary, and a new purple lakeside place. Add an orange path from the old high terrace, passing the old lake and through a clear pass into the new valley and place. Show a second connector back into the old valley to support mental-map recognition and return. Keep the same simple flat gray mountains, blue water, orange paths, purple destinations. All background must be fully opaque light beige #EFEAD8. No labels, no decorative buildings, no perspective, no text. The purpose is testing semantic interface continuation and arrival feedback with the existing area locked, not repainting the old map.

annotations: 保留完整C01语义输入；只采用生成图北部的轮廓，丢弃模型重画的旧区域。
新轮廓经明确坐标映射置于旧区以北；通路从已有节点接出并回接，溪流末点引用已有湖面。
高度、接口控制点及回程连接由AI补充，不能从图片唯一恢复。
limitations: AI扩图没有保持旧区域或增大画布，此项输入保真失败。
原生单张heightmap最大513采样；范围1024→2048后间距2→4m，地形与部分依赖地形的制品可能改变，需独立比较，不能据输入未变宣称全场景无损扩展。
当前是语义接口续接，不证明跨区增量加载与任意3D扩图。
